narr: Thunderstorms produced isolated flash flooding. The storms occurred in the vicinity of a 500 mb trough that extended from the eastern Great Lakes southwest across the lower Ohio Valley. The convection itself was induced by a remnant mesoscale vorticity center that moved eastward from Missouri. The storms formed in an increasingly moist and unstable air mass. The wind flow aloft was weak, causing the storm motion to be driven by mesoscale processes. The storms propagated slowly east to southeast.
ev: Water was flowing over and covering Highways 356 and 257 just northwest of Otwell. Several other county roads just outside of Otwell were flooded as well.
